CustomField.description: Stages Mode flag. When checked, the page's stage card shows an 'Optional' badge and the page is excluded from the required-step completion totals shown in the stages overview. formTemplate.js sets the stage's view status to 'optional' when no persisted status exists, and the auto-created Form_Submission_Stage__c starts in 'Optional' status. Toggling it after stages are auto-created does not retroactively restatus existing stage records. No effect in the linear runtime. Default false.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this to mark the page optional in Stages Mode — its card shows an 'Optional' badge and it is left out of the required-steps progress count. This only affects Stages-mode templates, and changing it later will not restatus stage records already created on existing submissions.
CustomField.label: Is Optional
